preToolUse.bash: root="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT}}"; if [ -z "$root" ] || [ ! -f "$root/scripts/v2/sdd-soft-guard.mjs" ]; then printf '%s' '{"permissionDecision":"allow"}'; exit 0; fi; NODE_COMPILE_CACHE="$root/../../.sdd-compile-cache" NODE_COMPILE_CACHE_PORTABLE=1 NODE_COMPILE_CACHE_READONLY=1 node --config-file="$root/config/hook.node.json" --disallow-code-generation-from-strings --env-file-if-exists=.sdd/env "$root/scripts/v2/sdd-soft-guard.mjs" --emit copilot
preToolUse.powershell: $root = $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; if (-not $root) { $root = $env:PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not $root) { $root = $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT }; $guard = if ($root) { Join-Path $root 'scripts/v2/sdd-soft-guard.mjs' } else { $null }; if (-not $guard -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $guard)) { [Console]::Out.Write('{"permissionDecision":"allow"}'); exit 0 }; $env:NODE_COMPILE_CACHE = Join-Path $root '../../.sdd-compile-cache'; $env:NODE_COMPILE_CACHE_PORTABLE = '1'; $env:NODE_COMPILE_CACHE_READONLY = '1'; & node "--config-file=$(Join-Path $root 'config/hook.node.json')" --disallow-code-generation-from-strings --env-file-if-exists=.sdd/env $guard --emit copilot
